name: Pure Morning: Doji / Morning Doji Star above EMA60
author: Pine community script

instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Doji or Morning Doji Star formation (bar[2] long bearish body > 60% of range, bar[1] open within 0.09% tolerance of its close, third bar bullish) with close above EMA(60).
exit: strategy.exit with percentage stop/limit and ATR-based trailing offsets (trail_points/offset), plus optional close on signal.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Doji threshold and SL/TP numbers are script inputs not all captured; only long side.
